_comment: Models a human has approved as in-scope but that no source has measured yet.
This file exists because models.json is regenerated from scratch by every ingest
run, so a hand-added entry there would be erased by the next cron. A model with no
scores also has no composite, so it cannot be a models.json row at all.
Approving a model here is not ranking it. It pre-registers the name so the ingest
recognises it the moment a source publishes a measurement, instead of it being
discovered weeks later. Scores, provider, release date and coverage stay empty until
Layer A fills them from a real source.
Entries are added by a human from data/onboarding.json drafts. Nothing writes here
